name: Conan Chronicles 1
summary: This Campaign is set in the Hyborian World of Conan and consists of a three-part adventure, \"The Legions of the Dead\", \"The Scythian Pits\" and \"The Thing in the Crypt\" and includes custom races, feats, deities, monsters, music and items to fit a Hyborian setting. Play as Conan or as your own Hyborian hero starting their first adventure.
